newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AAA to NTT's $300 mln mortgage bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AAA to NTT's $300 mln mortgage bond.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Thursday that it had assigned its AAA long-term rating to Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp's (NTT) $300 million straight mortgage bond due on December 13, 2001.
The rating outlook was negative, it said in a statement.
S&P said a final decision on the potential break-up of NTT into one long-distance and two regional telephone companies was not expected until spring 1997.

A near-term rating change was not anticipated unless the Japanese government gave final approval for the break-up, or until sufficient details of the restructuring became available, it said in the statement.

"Regardless of a potential break-up, heightening competition in the Japanese telecommunications industry could have adverse effects on NTT's dominant market position in the future," the rating agency said.
